observations.B01: Ink has a two-curved 3 followed by a closed-loop 8.
observations.B02: The capital C stands above an insertion caret between the abbreviation ens. and d’arêtes. A clipped stroke from the preceding line is excluded.
observations.B03: Both graph letters have separate underline strokes; the first has a high prime. The final label digit has the closed, angular form read as 6.
observations.B04: The raised phrase has a descending g and repeated m humps, read as diagramme de; it is connected by an insertion guide above morphismes. The baseline final s is visible.
observations.B05: The small mark above the upper-left M is separately canceled and may be a hat. Hatching crosses the upper horizontal arrow, upper-right object and right descending hooked arrow. The left descending hook and bottom horizontal arrow survive. The upper-right hat remains uncertain under the hatching. Lower-edge prose fragments are excluded.
observations.B06: Rotated marginal note: the first word has connected ascending and descending strokes that do not decide between the proposed readings. The raised exclamation consists of a stem and dot; the independent terminal exclamation is separate. Unrelated body fragments at the lower-right edge are excluded.
observations.B07: Each Gamma carries an exclamation stem and dot. The first expression ends in an un-underlined C; both G subscripts in the second have underline strokes. Marginal-note overlap at the left and diagram fragments above are excluded.
observations.B08: The final shorthand after lui- has compressed strokes and an elevated short horizontal mark; an expansion is not silently selected. Neighboring-line fragments at top and bottom are excluded.
observations.B09: Two horizontal deletion strokes obscure the internal letters of the phrase beneath the raised horizontal. The surviving ascenders and rounded letters leave de droite/du haut uncertain. Adjacent marginal ink at the lower-left edge is excluded.
observations.B10: The word factorise has a long descending f followed by a high t and terminal rounded e. Clipped next-line ascenders below are excluded.
observations.B11: The crossed short word has an ascending d and following e; une is written above it. The following target words read immersion de multiplicités. Preceding clipped edge marks and the formula hat at bottom are excluded.
observations.B12: The two M letters have hats; the Gamma exponent has a distinct dot, and the arrow has an open hooked tail. Two tiny dark marks beside the label may be punctuation and are left uncertain. Marginal fragments at the upper-left and lower-edge ink are excluded.
observations.B13: Rotated note has a clear underline under locales. Overlapping body strokes obscure the short phrase after locales and the end of the final line; uncertain wording is retained. The sloping body text, formula label (98), and lower-edge fragments are excluded from the marginal reading.
observations.B14: The first M has a distinct hat; both G subscripts have underline strokes. Underlines run beneath germe de and multiplicité across the line break. Overlapping marginal text at left and neighboring-line edge fragments are excluded.
observations.B15: The word has the initial i/n strokes, a clear d ascender, and a final tall t with short cross stroke: induite. Clipped unrelated ink at the top and left is excluded.
observations.B16: The first M is bare and the target M has a hat. The group-letter stem has an extra lower loop and short middle stroke, so Gamma/E is not decided. Neither G inside that group subscript shows a clear underline, unlike the M subscripts. The word induite above and separate pencil foliation below are excluded.
observations.B17: Rotated note has separate underlines under immersion and locale. Both M symbols beside the horizontal arrow are bare. The group exponent is congested and the second group-subscript underline is uncertain. The last M expression is retained as visible note ink without supplying a connecting phrase. Slanting main-text fragments, formula (99), and pencil foliation are excluded.
observations.B18: Two light pencil sevens each have a crossbar; the dark lower page boundary is excluded.
